chunks: And by his chain, he said: Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Marry the matches and marry among them, and choose for your seed.

key_terms.الْأَكْفَاءَ: The compatible or equal matches in marriage

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith 'Marry the matches' mean in Shia Islamic tradition?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith to establish the principle of *kafa'ah* (compatibility) not merely as a social formality but as a spiritual imperative for preserving the quality of the progeny (*nutfah*). This instruction reflects the Shia emphasis on selecting spouses who possess both moral integrity and lineage suitability, ensuring the continuity of virtuous traits within the family unit.
